_meta.description: TD network edge-recall golden set: find_connections coverage of every TD RelationshipType over the committed fixture (ADR-0062 Part D2)
_meta.usage: scripts/benchmark/run_caller_recall.py run --project-path tests/fixtures/td_network --golden-path evaluation/td_caller_golden.json --relationship-types wires_to docked_to references_op binds_to exports_to scripted_by contains
_meta.requires: chunking.enable_td_network_indexing=true for the project at project_path, and --relationship-types on the run (without it analyze_impact only reports 'calls' edges, which TD chunks never emit, so every query scores 0.0)
_meta.normalization: Chunk IDs have line-range portions stripped and are relative to project_path
_meta.format: Each query names a target chunk, the report.relationships field(s) to read (names from get_relationship_field_mapping()), and the expected chunk IDs found under those fields. 'expected_callers' is kept for compatibility with the caller-recall harness; direction is always 'callers'.
_meta.stub_note: TE006 expects the exporter stub node for /project1/external/mix1; its chunk id is the stub's path relative to the walked root's parent as emitted by TDNetworkChunker.

categories.E: Edge coverage per TD relationship type

_meta.relevance_scale: binary: an expected chunk is either found under the named field or not

queries.description: glsl1 -> docked info DAT (dock edge, reverse field)
info1 scripts comp1 (scripted_by edge, reverse field)
exportsrc1 exports to the external mix1 stub (forward field)
noise1 forward wire and reverse script reference
